key_highlights: ASX flat overall; miners and tech lead gains while oil stocks struggle on Saudi supply shock (26, 43)
Aussie flash PMI sags, signalling softening domestic demand amid RBA rate hike pressure on household spending (34, 38)
Gold exploration sector active: Critical Resources surges on Suriname grab, Aurum raises $52.5M, Platina, Dalaroo, Advance all advancing (8, 16, 45, 47, 48)
Global diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine wars to persist into 2027, spiking Australian fuel prices (46, 58, 50)
Chinese property recovery uncertain amid Xi political pressure; China pivoting to robotics (24, 55, 69)
Property market cooling: rising listings, falling demand pushing prices lower (21)
Jetstar industrial action escalates with fee waivers; Qantas confirms SYD-JFK non-stop (40, 42, 29)
Coalition threatens to dismantle climate/offshore wind laws; energy policy remains contested (7, 28, 30)

sectors.trend: Miners outperform on gold exploration momentum; iron ore/coal subdued. Multiple ASX gold juniors advancing (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina, Dalaroo, Advance). Silver discovery at Advance (4120g/t) notable.
sectors.implications: Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk (Iran, Ukraine). BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX likely flat-to-soft on iron ore. Gold juniors offer speculative upside but carry execution risk.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggle on Saudi supply shock and diesel shortage narrative. Coalition threatens to unwind climate laws and offshore wind, creating policy uncertainty. Data centre energy demand strains net-zero targets.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) face headwinds from diesel supply disruption. Coal (BLL.AX, WES.AX) may see mixed impact. Offshore wind developers face political risk from Coalition policy reversal.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending, pressuring NIMs and credit quality. RAC WA insurance arm sale blocked by watchdog, signalling regulatory friction. Government debt trajectory concerning.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle. Insurance (IAG.AX, CGF.AX) watch regulatory developments. Fiscal deterioration (54) could pressure sovereign credit and bond yields.

sectors.trend: Tech leads ASX higher on Wall Street surge; AMD hits record. China pivoting to robotics. ADARx seeks $1.74B US IPO. AI/semiconductor momentum strong globally.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) benefits from global semiconductor rally. China robotics pivot (55) could support ASX industrials. ADARx IPO signals global biotech/tech appetite.

sectors.trend: Myer jumps on ASX. Jetstar industrial action escalates. Qantas confirms SYD-JFK non-stop. RBA rate pressure on household spending. El Nino threatens agricultural output.
sectors.implications: MYR.AX positive momentum. QAN.AX benefits from route expansion but faces Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial risk. Consumer staples (WES.AX, CBA.AX) defensive appeal rises as spending tightens.

sectors.trend: Syngenis gains precision medicine firepower. ADARx $1.74B US IPO. CSL remains key ASX healthcare anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX benefits from global biotech sentiment. Syngenis (SYG.AX) and small-cap biotech see capital inflows. ADARx IPO validates sector valuations.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand pushing property prices lower. Chinese property recovery uncertain. El Nino risk to agricultural REITs.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face rental pressure. Property developers (MRG.AX, LVH.AX) under pressure. Monitor Chinese property recovery for global risk sentiment.

key_themes: RBA rate cycle squeezing household balance sheets, dampening consumption
Gold exploration boom across ASX juniors on geopolitical safe-haven demand
Diesel/oil supply shock from Iran-Ukraine wars creating energy inflation risk into 2027
Chinese economic rebalancing toward robotics; property recovery uncertain
Energy policy political contest between Labor and Coalition on climate laws
Industrial action in aviation (Jetstar) and Tasmanian job cuts signal labour market stress
Fiscal deterioration across federal and state governments
Global tech/semiconductor rally (AMD record) lifting ASX tech

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Diesel/oil supply shock and energy inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour integrated majors (WDS.AX, BHP.AX) over pure-play oil. Monitor A$ fuel prices weekly.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate pressure on household spending and credit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favour defensive staples (WES.AX, CBA.AX). Monitor NAB/CBA credit loss provisions.
Limit iron ore/coal exposure (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX). Diversify into gold and domestic-demand names.
Monitor 10-yr A-gil yields; favour quality dividend payers. Watch state government bond issuance.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy policy reversal risk (Coalition climate law threat)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid offshore wind and renewable policy-dependent names pre-election. Favour established energy majors.
Monitor Jetstar (JLH.AX) and QAN.AX operational disruption. Diversify transport exposure.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX gold miners and explorers
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk premium, multiple ASX gold juniors advancing, safe-haven demand amid diesel shock and Chinese uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add ASX tech/semiconductor exposure on global rally
opportunities.rationale: AMD record, Wall Street surge, China robotics pivot; ASX tech lags global peers

opportunities.recommendation: Favour defensive consumer staples and banks
opportunities.rationale: RBA rate pressure on spending; quality dividend payers offer resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge oil/gas pure-play exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Diesel shortage and Saudi supply shock create volatile, unpredictable energy pricing; policy risk from Coalition climate reversal

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore/coal exposure pending China data
defensive_moves.rationale: Chinese property recovery uncertain, Xi under political pressure, demand outlook soft
Rising listings, falling demand, El Nino risk to ag REITs, rate pressure on valuations

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound (5,200–5,400 ^AXJO) with sector rotation: gold and tech outperform, oil and property lag. RBA rate pressure and PMI softness cap upside. Diesel shock adds volatility. Jetstar industrial action a minor drag on transport.
market_outlook.long_term: Moderate constructive bias if RBA pivots and Chinese property stabilises. Gold miners and tech offer structural upside. Energy policy uncertainty and fiscal deterioration cap re-rating. El Nino and migration policy shifts add noise. 6–12 month target 5,500–5,700 ^AXJO.

ASX gold junior pipeline (PLA.AX, ADV.AX, GRC.AX)
